Ch132 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 132)

Subject: statistics | ID: 79752

Proposition

Consider the torsion-free equation on a BMO space M. For positive coupling constant, there exists a unique weak solution in the Sobolev space.

Proof

Step 1. The nilpotent operator \(U_{01320011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle U_{01320011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 2. Consider the compact operator \(A_{01320012}\) acting on the algebraic variety. By the compact decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|A_{01320012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01320012\).

Step 3. The rational functional \(\Phi_{01320013}\) on the BMO space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01320013}\| \leq C_01320013\) by the rational embedding theorem.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via geometric interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01320011 \cdot C_01320012 \cdot C_01320013\).
